rules.name: uplink modal length
rules.definition: max exact-length count / uplink records; >=8 uplink records; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included

rules.name: downlink modal length
rules.definition: max exact-length count / downlink records; >=8 downlink records; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included

rules.name: shared modal length
rules.definition: max_L min(uplink_fraction[L], downlink_fraction[L]); >=8 each direction; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included

rules.name: low length entropy
rules.definition: 1 - Shannon entropy(length)/log2(record count); >=16 total records; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included
rules.transport_hypothesis: Broaden the length distribution rather than only changing one fixed size.

rules.name: strict direction alternation
rules.definition: adjacent direction changes / adjacent pairs; >=16 records; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included; abstains when cross-direction ordering is ambiguous under 3bedeecc9596777cf4f858748590a9c3b0380bc78b84de0518fd7a051972ca42

rules.name: equal opposite-direction neighbors
rules.definition: opposite-direction adjacent equal-length pairs / all adjacent pairs; >=16 records; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included; abstains when cross-direction ordering is ambiguous under 3bedeecc9596777cf4f858748590a9c3b0380bc78b84de0518fd7a051972ca42

rules.name: regular uplink clock
rules.definition: 1/(1+CV(positive uplink gaps)); >=8 gaps and >=200 ms span; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included

rules.name: regular downlink clock
rules.definition: 1/(1+CV(positive downlink gaps)); >=8 gaps and >=200 ms span; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included
rules.transport_hypothesis: Avoid a separate fixed downlink clock.

rules.name: uplink phase grid
rules.definition: max circular phase concentration at fixed10/20/25/40/45/50/100 ms grids; >=9 uplink records, span>=200 ms; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included
rules.transport_hypothesis: Use nonperiodic timing; uniform jitter can leave a detectable phase grid.

rules.name: immediate paired reply
rules.definition: uplink immediately followed by downlink within10 ms / uplink count; >=8 uplink and >=16 total; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included; abstains when cross-direction ordering is ambiguous under 3bedeecc9596777cf4f858748590a9c3b0380bc78b84de0518fd7a051972ca42
rules.transport_hypothesis: Decouple server reply timing from each poll where operationally acceptable.

rules.name: narrow uplink padding band
rules.definition: 1-(q90(length)-q10(length))/(q90(length)+q10(length)); >=10 uplink records; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included
rules.transport_hypothesis: Use a wider measured size mixture.

rules.name: two dominant lengths
rules.definition: mass of two most frequent exact lengths / all records; >=16 records; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included
rules.transport_hypothesis: Avoid a two-size mixture that only replaces one fixed size.

rules.name: frequent small uplink records
rules.definition: fraction uplink records<=512 bytes; >=8 uplink records, span>=200 ms; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included
rules.transport_hypothesis: Measure idle polling leakage; reduce unnecessary small periodic writes.

rules.name: duplex byte symmetry
rules.definition: 1-abs(up_bytes-down_bytes)/(up_bytes+down_bytes); >=16 records, >=4 each direction; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included
rules.transport_hypothesis: Avoid forced byte symmetry when real workloads are asymmetric.

rules.name: sustained fixed-cell polling
rules.definition: min(shared modal length, direction alternation, fraction occupied200 ms bins having both directions); >=3 occupied bins and >=8 each direction; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included; abstains when cross-direction ordering is ambiguous under 3bedeecc9596777cf4f858748590a9c3b0380bc78b84de0518fd7a051972ca42
rules.transport_hypothesis: Combine length, timing and directional changes; changing one feature may leave the composite signature.

rules.name: Exact26 byte TLS23 record share
rules.definition: records with full TLS record length26/all TLS23 records; >=16 records; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included

rules.name: Tiny TLS23 record share
rules.definition: records with full TLS record length<=64/all TLS23 records; >=16 records; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included

rules.name: Whole-flow length concentration
rules.definition: 1-Shannon(length)/log2(N); >=16 records; exact histogram; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included

rules.name: Whole-flow directional byte balance
rules.definition: 1-abs(upBytes-downBytes)/(upBytes+downBytes); >=16 records, >=4 eachdirection; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included

rules.name: Whole-flow adjacent reply share
rules.definition: up immediately followed bydown in0..10ms/upN; >=16 records, >=8 up; no negative adjacency; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included; abstains when cross-direction ordering is ambiguous under 3bedeecc9596777cf4f858748590a9c3b0380bc78b84de0518fd7a051972ca42

rules.name: Whole-flow directional regularity
rules.definition: max eligible direction1/(1+CVpositive gaps); >=8gaps and200ms span; within actual TCP flow only; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included

rules.name: Capture-order direction alternation
rules.definition: Among canonical earliest64 UTC-selected metadata records, order by original unique completion ordinal; direction changes/adjacent pairs, >=16 records. Sensor-conditioned arrival view; no claim of physical/time ordering.; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included

rules.name: Capture-order equal opposite neighbors
rules.definition: Among same UTC-selected metadata records sorted by original completion ordinal, adjacent opposite-direction equal-length pairs/adjacent pairs, >=16 records; no time comparison or invented timestamps.; G04 unit: complete outerTLS23 HEADER availability, declared body length plus5, NOT delivered ciphertext length or body completion; encrypted handshakes included
